description: Create multiple segments in a trip in one call. To save into a trip that does not exist yet, send new_trip (title, start_date, end_date) instead of trip_id: the trip and its items are created in this one call. Put each item's values in fields, named as segment_get_schema returns them (Activity activityType is one of: tour, dining, show, spa, class, sports, sightseeing, other). Each item succeeds or fails on its own: valid items are created and failed items are returned by index with the reason, so resend only the failed items. Max 50 segments per call; split larger itineraries into several calls. Segment dates must fall within the parent trip dates. Dates up to 1 day outside the trip extend it, with a warning; further out, call trip_update first. For an Activity, Lodging, EventTicket or Parking at a real place, call places_search first and put the result's place ID in fields.placeId: Tineo links that place (map pin and coordinates) and fills a missing name, address, phone and website. Never invent a time: if the user has not given or chosen one, ask, or send the date only (YYYY-MM-DD) in startDateTime and Tineo stores it as time not set. Send a clock time only when the user stated it or a booking shows it. For commercial cruise reservations and sea/port days use cruise_* tools. Never substitute Activity, CruiseActivity or another segment type for a cruise day. Ordinary shore excursions remain valid Activity/CruiseActivity. If cruise tools are unavailable explain the limitation and ask for clarification. Cruise/CruiseDay generic writes require the dedicated cruise tools; their schemas and full reads remain available.

new_trip.description: Use instead of trip_id to create the trip and its segments in one call. A trip of the user's with the same title and dates is reused.

end_date.description: Trip end date in YYYY-MM-DD format

start_date.description: Trip start date in YYYY-MM-DD format

title.description: Human-readable destination name, such as 'Lisbon' (not airport codes)

segments.description: Array of segments to create. Each must have segment_type and fields.

fields.description: Field values for this segment, named as segment_get_schema returns them for segment_type. Activity activityType is one of: tour, dining, show, spa, class, sports, sightseeing, other.

segment_type.description: Segment type: Flight, Lodging, CarRental, Train, Transfer, Ferry, EventTicket, Parking, Activity, Note, Poll

trip_id.description: The trip ID to add segments to. Send this or new_trip.
